epic.title: Teacher Leave Management Module
epic.body: Provides teachers with a centralized dashboard to review, approve, or reject student leave requests with class-wise filtering, search capabilities, and audit trails for review comments.

features.title: Student Leave Request Review
features.body: Allows teachers to manage the lifecycle of student leave applications, including real-time status updates and communication of review feedback.

stories.title: Leave Management Dashboard & Filtering
stories.body: Implement the teacher's leave dashboard with summary stats and multi-level filtering for student requests.
acceptanceCriteria: Summary: Display real-time counts for Pending, Approved, and Rejected requests in the header.
Class Selector: Dropdown to filter requests by teacher-assigned classes (e.g., 7A, 7B).
Status Filter: Toggle buttons to filter the list by 'all', 'pending', 'approved', or 'rejected'.
Search: Search bar to filter requests by student name, roll number, or class.
Sorting: Automatically sort list to show 'Pending' requests at the top, followed by date-based order.

stories.title: Leave Approval & Rejection Workflow
stories.body: Build the interactive review process including the decision modal and status visualization.
acceptanceCriteria: Action Buttons: Display 'Approve' and 'Reject' buttons only for requests in 'pending' status.
Review Modal: Dialog to add an optional review comment and confirm the approval/rejection action.
Detail View: Each card must show the leave period (with total day count), reason, and whether applied by student or parent.
Post-Review: Display the reviewer's name, comment, and review date for approved/rejected requests.

stories.title: Student Leave Retrieval API
stories.body: Endpoints to fetch student leave requests filtered by the teacher's organizational scope.
acceptanceCriteria: POST: Approve/Reject leave requests by teacherId and classId.
GET: Retrieve leave requests filtered by teacherId and classId.
Search/Filter: Support server-side filtering by status (pending/approved/rejected) and student metadata.
Metadata: Include details on who submitted the request (student vs parent) and parent contact info if applicable.

stories.title: Leave Decision Processing (CRUD)
stories.body: API to update the status of a leave request and persist audit logs.
acceptanceCriteria: PUT/PATCH: Update request status and append 'reviewedBy', 'reviewedOn', and 'reviewComment'.
Validation: Ensure a request can only be reviewed if it is currently in 'pending' state.
Integration: Status change must be visible to the student/parent profile immediately.
